name: Mech Cocoon
source:
An adventure visual novel game, inspired on scifi stories, mechs and personal struggles, it's a story based on Daiken, a man trapped without a clear purpose or path.

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/cocoon-mech-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款冒险视觉小说游戏，灵感源自科幻故事、机甲和个人奋斗，故事围绕大肯展开，大肯是一个被困在没有明确目标或道路的人。

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/cocoon-mech-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
